test_title: PYST 6: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means ‘A is the daughter of B’,

A – B means ‘A is the wife of B’,

A x B means ‘A is the father of B’ and

A ÷ B means ‘A is the brother of B’.

How is A related to S if ‘A + E – F x N ÷ S’?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Daughter
 Wife
 Father
 Brother
 
 

 

Given: ‘A + E – F x N ÷ S’

It means: A is the daughter of E, E is the wife of F, F is the Father of N, N is the brother of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ba92e4b2f22d3d714f42eeeb04c19156d62e362873759be5df0bfdbfed09083.png] 

So, A is the 'Sister' of S.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
